evidence.quote: On the Moon there is no air, so a thrown ball feels no drag at all.
Nothing pushes the ball sideways, so the horizontal speed stays U0 for the whole flight
and the ball moves x = U0 * t across the ground.
The vertical speed is V = V0 - g * t, and the height is y = V0 * t - g * t^2 / 2.
The ball stops rising when V = 0, which happens at t = V0 / g.
Putting that time into the height equation gives the highest point: ymax = V0^2 / (2 * g).

objectives: Describe drag-free ballistic flight with uniform horizontal motion and vertically accelerated motion
Calculate horizontal position as x = U0 * t and vertical position as y = V0 * t - g * t^2 / 2
Calculate maximum height as ymax = V0^2 / (2 * g)
